# 9. No new kind of customer message without approval

Date: 2026-09-20

## Status

Accepted

## Context

The decision came up on 2026-09-20; the people involved needed one rule to point at.

## Decision

**Words:** 「Nothing goes to a customer until I have approved that kind of message.」 — Mira Example, 2026-09-20

**Options considered:**
- no product sends a new kind of message to a customer (email, sms or push) until mira has approved that kind of message in this decision log (chosen)
- leave it undecided — rejected: the question keeps coming back

**Recommended:** the chosen option.

**Decision key:** customer-outreach

No product sends a new kind of message to a customer (email, SMS or push) until Mira has approved that kind of message in this decision log.

## Consequences

Later work follows this rule until a newer record supersedes it.
